Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Is there a free trial or product demo available?
Yes, Talview offers a product walkthrough, allowing you to explore our features and see how our solutions can meet your needs before you actually buy the solution.
Do you offer bundled pricing or packages for specific features?
Yes, Talview provides pricing options for both individual features and bundled packages, allowing you to select the best combination that suits your needs.
Are there any charges involved during the pilot phase?
For the pilot phase, additional charges may apply for more than 10 candidates. Pricing will vary based on the number of candidates and the selected features.
What is the minimum number of units a customer must purchase to make a commitment?
To get started, a minimum commitment of approximately 150 to 200 candidates is typically required.
How does your pricing model work for your products?
Our pricing model is unit-based, which means each feature has a specific unit assigned to it. This way, you only pay for what you use and can easily scale based on your needs.
